articles.title: Sarina Wiegman: England Women boss signs new two-year contract extension through to end of Euro 2029
articles.summary: England Women boss Sarina Wiegman signs two-year contract extension; new deal ensures 56-year-old will lead Lionesses through to the end of Euro 2029; Wiegman's previous deal was set to expire at the end of 2027 World Cup; Wiegman has won back-to-back European Championships with England
articles.body:
The 56-year-old's previous deal was set to expire at the end of the 2027 World Cup.

The new deal gives Wiegman the chance to guide England to a third straight European Championship title after earning the Lionesses' first major trophy with Euro 2022 victory, followed by a successful defence three years later.

Under Wiegman, England also finished as World Cup runners-up in 2023 after a final defeat by Spain.

The new contract extension is set to see Wiegman's time in charge as England Women boss reach eight years after her first game in 2021.

Wiegman, who also won the 2017 Euros with her native Netherlands, said: "I am so happy to be able to carry on with this squad and cannot think of a better job in football. Working for a world-class organisation like The FA, and alongside so many people dedicated to winning England teams and the growth of our game, excites me every day.

"I am grateful to Mark Bullingham, Debbie Hewitt and the FA Board for the incredible way they have backed me, my coaches and support team and, of course, the players.

"I am honoured by their trust, which I never take for granted and want to keep this great partnership going. I have such a strong desire to see what more we can achieve together with our amazing fans.

"I also want to keep supporting the wonderful collaborative work being led by The FA across the women's game, particularly in developing young players and coaches.

"Of course, anyone who knows me will understand that my main concern right now is absolutely the World Cup, and helping this squad realise their potential in the years to come. We have an important job to do to confirm our place in Brazil, and hopefully we can do that and give the country another special summer to remember next year."

'No one better to lead Lionesses into next two tournaments'

Wiegman will aim to guide the Lionesses to the 2027 World Cup as England take on Ukraine over two legs in the final play-off round in December, with the winners of the tie progressing to the tournament in Brazil.

Last year, Wiegman, who has also won two Arnold Clark Cups and the first Women's Finalissima against Brazil, was voted as the Best FIFA Women's Coach for a record-extending fifth time.

FA chief executive Mark Bullingham said: "Sarina is an incredible coach, with an unparalleled record in major tournaments and I am so happy to continue to work with her for the next EURO cycle.

"While we will all remember the trophies and thrilling moments she has given us, I know she is only looking forward. There is no one better to lead the Lionesses into the next two tournaments.

"Sarina's impact on English football has been immense, and she continues to inspire so many throughout the game. We have so much more to do in the women's game and she will be instrumental in helping us to achieve that."

Wiegman's new deal will also encompass the 2027 Nations League, which serves as a qualifying tournament for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics.

FA Chief Football Officer Dan Ashworth added: "We have been aware for a long time now that this is a golden age for women's football in this country, and Sarina has played a significant part.

"In Sarina, we have an elite coach who has won consistently while operating at the highest tactical level, embracing innovation and never standing still. Her record is remarkable.

"While Sarina is fuelled by a determination to keep on winning and to support the growth of the game, her humility also shines through. It is never about her but always about a desire to maximise the potential within players to be the best they can be."

Sky Sports' Laura Hunter: "News of Sarina Wiegman's contract extension comes as something of a surprise. The assumption was that she would lead England into next summer's World Cup and that would likely be her fourth and final major tournament cycle.

"England have reached the final of every tournament under her charge, her record close to flawless.

"But the Dutchwoman has had to field more scrutiny over the past 12 months, much of it surrounding what many believe to be a stagnation of England's development. The bar for the Lionesses is extremely high. They are the two-time European champions and must be judged against the world's best.

"So when they fell 4-0 to Spain recently and failed to qualify automatically for Brazil 2027, it drew criticism. But it was also a necessary reality check, and an opportunity for Wiegman to embrace the change she had resisted within her squad of champions.

"There are some young, exciting talents coming through England's ranks. That much was demonstrated by 20-year-old Lexi Potter during the most recent international window.

"Wiegman must see the potential in the next generation. And there is perhaps no better coach on the international scene to help them realise that potential. Now she can focus fully on how England might go about winning their first women's World Cup - and what can be achieved beyond."

articles.title: Manzambi: de 'Mejor Joven' de la Europa League y revelación del Mundial... a sensación de la Premier
articles.standfirst: El nuevo 'juguete' de Emery suma tres dianas y dos asistencias en los últimos cuatro partidos
articles.summary: El nuevo 'juguete' de Emery suma tres dianas y dos asistencias en los últimos cuatro partidos
articles.body: Johan Manzambi (Ginebra, 2005) no deja de sorprender. El 'todocampista' suizo venía de completar una temporada para enmarcar -anotó siete dianas y repartió nueve asistencias en 47 partidos- que guiaron al Friburgo a alcanzar la final de la Europa League y le valieron para ser elegido 'Mejor Joven' del torneo. No contento con ello, se erigió en una de las grandes revelaciones del Mundial. Manzambi anotó tres dianas y repartió dos pases de gol en los cuatro partidos que disputó antes de que una inoportuna contusión en la rodilla le privara de disputar los octavos y los cuartos. Parecía que lo tenía hecho con el Newcastle, pero, casualidad o no, terminó firmando por el equipo que goleó a 'su' Friburgo (0-3) en la final de la Europa League. El Aston Villa no se lo pensó y terminó convirtiendo al suizo en el fichaje más caro (60 millones) de su historia. En un nuevo giro del destino, Manzambi rubricó frente al Newcastle (0-1) su gran inicio de curso anotando el gol del triunfo. Superados definitivamente los problemas en la rodilla que le llevaron a perderse los primeros cinco partidos del curso, el ex del Friburgo acumula tres dianas y dos asistencias en los últimos cuatro partidos que ha disputado a las órdenes de Unai Emery. "Estoy muy contento de haber marcado y, aunque lo más importante son los tres puntos, espero poder volver a hacerlo en el próximo partido. Jugué contra el Aston Villa en la final de la Europa League y sabía que un muy buen equipo con un gran entrenador. Estaba seguro de que era perfecto para mí", reconocía tras marcar en St. James' Park. Tres días antes de su gol al Newcastle, coincidiendo con su 21 cumpleaños, se estrenó como goleador en Champions en la victoria sobre el Fenerbahçe (6-0). "Estoy muy feliz, es mi primer partido en Champions. Mi primer gol. Es mi cumpleaños. Mi familia está aquí, ha sido muy bonito", admitía. "En un año, ¡guau!, mejoró rapidísimo. Fue progresando cada vez más y mejorando. Intentamos ficharlo y lo conseguimos: es fantástico. Deseaba unirse al Villa para ofrecer ese mismo rendimiento los próximos 3-4 años y ha tenido un impacto muy positivo”, asegura Emery, que alcanzó ante el Newcastle su victoria número 100 en la Premier. El exentrenador de Lorca, Almería, Valencia, Spartak Moscú, Sevilla, PSG, Arsenal y Villarreal está encantado con su nuevo 'juguete': "Es un jugador versátil ,puede conducir, llegar al área, dar asistencias y marcar goles. Tiene habilidad e inteligencia y su físico también es muy importante para ayudarnos en defensa y para intentar mantener los duelos en ataque”. "Ahora estamos viendo lo importante que será, tanto en el presente como en el futuro", insiste Emery. Su 'techo', desde luego, es imposible de predicir. Fue el 'Mejor Joven' de la Europa League, se convirtió en una de las revelaciones del Mundial... y ahora también causa sensación en la Premier.

articles.title: El Betis presentará este martes alegaciones al acta de De Burgos por la expulsión de Facundo Bernal
articles.standfirst: El mediocentro uruguayo podría ser sancionado con varios partidos de suspensión
articles.summary: El mediocentro uruguayo podría ser sancionado con varios partidos de suspensión
articles.body: Los servicios jurídicos del Betis, después de valorar las pruebas videográficas del partido frente al Barcelona y el acta de Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea, han decidido presentar mañana alegaciones a la misma. El Comité de Disciplina se reunirá el miércoles para determinar las sanciones de la novena jornada de LaLiga EA Sports y al mediocentro uruguayo podrían caerle varios partidos de suspensión. El colegiado vasco reflejó en los siguientes términos la expulsión de Facundo Bernal: "En el transcurso de una confrontación, este jugador sujetó a un adversario por el cuello y le propinó dos cabezazos en el rostro de forma consecutiva, no estando el balón en juego. El jugador rival no precisó de asistencia médica y pudo continuar el encuentro". Minutos antes de cumplirse la hora de partido, con el 2-3 en el marcador, Fermín estaba tendido en el suelo justo en el instante previo al gol de Abde. Los jugadores del Betis, con el meta Álvaro Valles, corrieron a levantar al futbolista del Barcelona. Lamine Yamal intervino y acabó enfrentándose con Bernal. En los vídeos se comprueba cómo Lamine Yamal empuja primero con su cuerpo y su cabeza a Facundo, algo que el juez asistente intentó impedir sin suerte. De Burgos Bengoetxea resolvió con una tarjeta amarilla para el futbolista del Barcelona y una roja directa para el bético. Manuel Pellegrini tenía clara la secuencia de la jugada y así lo valoró en sala de prensa a la conclusión del encuentro: "Lamine Yamal lo provoca y Facundo respondió. Cualquier árbitro con criterio futbolístico llama a los dos jugadores, le muestra amarilla a cada uno, pero no puede perjudicar a un jugador porque respondió a una agresión. Ahí se terminó el partido. No tenía que ser expulsado ninguno de los dos o los dos". Facundo Bernal, por su parte, pidió perdón en sus redes sociales. "Quiero pedir disculpas a mis compañeros y a la afición del Real Betis por haber dejado hoy al equipo con un jugador menos. No suelo reaccionar así y debí controlarme en esa jugada. Asumo la responsabilidad y no volverá a ocurrir", escribió el uruguayo. En principio se teme que puedan ser cuatro los partidos de sanción, perdiéndose de forma consecutiva los duelos ante Celta, Navalcarnero (Copa del Rey), Málaga y Elche. El siguiente ya es el derbi, que apunta al sábado 21 de noviembre.

articles.title: La policía gala tranquiliza al Barça ante los graves disturbios en París
articles.standfirst: Las protestas han acabado en serios incidentes: incendios, saqueos, miles de detenidos...
articles.summary: Las protestas han acabado en serios incidentes: incendios, saqueos, miles de detenidos...
articles.body: El Barcelona visita París en un momento de grave tensión en Francia. Las protestas sociales han acabado, sobre todo este pasado fin de semana, en serios disturbios (incendios, saqueos, más de 2.000 detenidos...) que incluso provocaron ayer domingo la comparecencia de urgencia del presidente Emmanuel Macron. La policía gala, no obstante, aseguró hace sólo unos minutos al Barça, que llega este mediodía a la capital del país vecino, que el partido no corre ningún peligro y que su estancia en tierras francesas estará marcada por el orden y la tranquilidad. Pero ante la convulsa situación, se reforzará la seguridad. "Habrá total normalidad". Ese es el mensaje que los cuerpos de seguridad de París han trasladado a los Mossos d'Esquadra en relación a la estancia del Barcelona y la disputa del encuentro de Champions League de mañana martes. La policía gala aseguró que los graves disturbios que en los últimos días han alterado el país vecino, y que especialmente han sido virulentos en la capital, no afectarán al conjunto catalán ni al desarrollo del partido, correspondiente a la tercera jornada de la fase de la liguilla. El inicio de la movilización social reside en las protestas estudiantiles (de universidades e institutos) que comenzaron a principios de este mes. Los jóvenes denunciaron la falta de profesores, las condiciones de las instalaciones educativas, la insuficiencia de las becas... pero pronto ese malestar por el estado de la educación pública se extendió al resto de sectores sociales (agricultores, transportistas, sindicatos, ecologistas, trabajadores...) que denunciaron la subida del coste de vida, el aumento del precio del combustible, las políticas fiscales del actual gobierno, el cambio climático, el deterioro de los servicios públicos... Las manifestaciones multitudinarias reivindicativas, que ya se han traslado a algunas ciudades de Italia (Milán, Turín, Bolonia, Génova...), fueron especialmente destacadas y con graves consecuencias este pasado fin de semana, ya que algunas acabaron en violentos enfrentamientos con las fuerzas de seguridad y desembocaron en incendios y saqueos en algunas ciudades. Más de medio millón de personas salieron a la calle en unas 90 concentraciones. En una declaración solemne desde el Palacio del Elíseo, Emmanuel Macron, presidente de la República francesa aseguró, ayer domingo, sentir "rabia y vergüenza al ver las calles de nuestras ciudades destrozadas". Según los balances provisionales que han sido facilitados, los disturbios han dejado alrededor de 2.400 detenidos en todo el país, 1.000 agentes y bomberos heridos, una persona fallecida tras sufrir un paro cardiorrespiratorio, 3.000 comercios asaltados... Uno de los incidentes más graves sucedió en Limoges, donde el histórico Ayuntamiento sufrió un incendio que destruyó buena parte del edificio y provocó el derrumbe de su torre. También hubo ataques contra comercios e instalaciones públicas en París, Marsella, Lyon y Burdeos... En estos momentos, el acceso al Museo del Louvre está boqueado por estudiantes de la Escuela del Louvre en apoyo al movimiento de los estudiantes de secundaria y para denunciar la represión policial, y el gobierno ha decretado toques de queda parcial. Pero la policía gala aseguró en los últimos minutos a los Mossos que este clima insurreccional no afectará la estadía de los culés. Se reforzará, además, la seguridad.

articles.title: Mbappé: “He demostrado una y otra vez que puedo hacer tonterías"
articles.standfirst: El delantero, elegido Onze d’Or al mejor jugador de la temporada 2025-26, se retrata en una entrevista en su versión más personal
articles.summary: El delantero, elegido Onze d’Or al mejor jugador de la temporada 2025-26, se retrata en una entrevista en su versión más personal
articles.body: Kylian Mbappé ha sido elegido Onze d’Or, el premio al mejor futbolista de la temporada que la revista francesa Onze Mondial concede desde 1976 mediante el voto de sus lectores, superando a Joao Neves y Kvaratskhelia. En la entrevista posterior, el delantero del Real Madrid se mostró en su versión más humana y empezó por desarmar el mito del chico perfecto. “Quien piense que soy perfecto, ¡no tiene televisión!”, bromeó. “He demostrado una y otra vez que puedo hacer tonterías. Y estoy de acuerdo con eso. Creo que también está bien”. El francés defendió que la pantalla deforma la percepción que la gente tiene de él: “Nadie te conoce de verdad a través de la televisión. Por eso a veces hay análisis que están en desfase con la realidad”. Y lo ilustró con un ejemplo: “Si me pides que juzgue a un actor del que solo he visto las películas, puedo dar una opinión completamente opuesta a lo que es la persona. Por eso yo no emito juicios, porque tengo la experiencia de pasar al otro lado de la pantalla y sé lo que es”. Lejos de rebajar la ambición que lo ha llevado a declararse el mejor del mundo, una frase que en Francia no siempre se entiende, Mbappé la defendió como una herramienta. “Lo comprendo todo. Conozco la historia y la cultura de mi país, así que sé lo que puede provocar cuando digo cosas así”, admitió. “Cuando lo digo es porque lo pienso y porque es una motivación. Para hacer grandes cosas, no puedes salir al campo pensando que otros lo pueden hacer mejor que tú. Sería ponerte un límite”. El francés reivindicó la duda como el motor de su longevidad en la elite. “No te conviertes en un jugador tan presente en el tiempo si no piensas, si no reflexionas, si no dudas”, aseguró. “La duda es muy importante, porque te permite superarte, no dormirte en los laureles. Reflexiono constantemente sobre lo que puedo hacer, lo que he hecho, lo que hago”. De su carrera, más de una década después de debutar, no dudó en la nota: “Un diez. Lo primero que me quedo no son los goles ni los títulos, sino que en estos diez u once años no me he aburrido ni un solo año. Nunca he echado el freno de mano”. Fiel a su idea de que a un futbolista se le cautiva hablándole de fútbol, Mbappé definió su próxima meta: comprender el juego a un nivel más profundo. “Quiero entender de verdad los momentos de un partido, de una temporada, de una acción. Tener más control sobre lo que hago, dejar menos espacio a lo desconocido”, explicó. No a costa de su esencia, eso sí: “Hay que dejar sitio a la creatividad y al instinto, porque forman parte de mi juego, y eso es algo que nunca debo perder”. Sobre cómo gestiona la presión de millones de personas, el delantero reivindicó la perspectiva que le han dado los años. “Es difícil si te lo tomas de manera personal, y yo me lo tomaba así de más joven”, reconoció. “Hoy tengo 27 años, tengo distancia, y entiendo que a veces hay gente que no busca analizar y que es así. Lo más importante es estar en sintonía con tus valores, con tus principios, con el mensaje que quieres enviar”. Y resumió su carácter en una imagen: “Soy un tío que se adapta. Más que un camaleón, un hijo del mundo”. También tuvo palabras para quienes sueñan con llegar a ser como él. “Les digo a todos esos niños que querer ser yo es ponerse un límite, y el objetivo de soñar es no ponerse límites”, afirmó. “Si pueden soñar con ser más que yo, ¡que no se frenen!”. El atacante rehuyó, además, cualquier lamento sobre las servidumbres de la fama: “Siempre me he sentido un privilegiado. Me parecería fuera de lugar, en el mundo en el que vivimos, quejarme de ser Kylian”. Preguntado por si es feliz, Mbappé respondió sin matices. “Claro que soy un hombre feliz. He tenido la vida que siempre quise tener. Siempre quise ser futbolista, y he cumplido mi sueño de jugar las mejores competiciones cada fin de semana”, zanjó. “¿Qué me haría falta para ser más feliz? Nada. En la vida no soy alguien que busque siempre tener más. En el trabajo sí, pero en la vida no. Hay que saber contentarse con lo que uno tiene”.

articles.title: París recupera la calma antes de recibir al Barça y el duelo ante el PSG no corre peligro
articles.standfirst: No hay manifestaciones previstas para mañana y el Parque de los Príncipes no se han adoptado medidas de seguridad especiales
articles.summary: No hay manifestaciones previstas para mañana y el Parque de los Príncipes no se han adoptado medidas de seguridad especiales
articles.body: París es un polvorín pero parece que la tensión se ha rebajado tras un fin de semana histórico, con manifestaciones e incidentes de los radicales en casi todas las grandes ciudades de Francia que han terminado con miles de detenidos, hasta 2.000 solo en París el pasado sábado. La jornada de hoy en París transcurre ya con más normalidad y esta tarde el Barcelona se ejercitará en el Parque de los Príncipes. Las calles a estas horas recobran la normalidad y en principio no hay nada previstas más movilizaciones, al menos importantes. Lo único destacado esta misma mañana ha sido el bloqueo por unos estudiantes del acceso al Louvre en apoyo a las protestas de los institutos. Se espera que 2.200 seguidores del Barça acudan a la capital el martes. La policía no ha calificado el encuentro como de alto riesgo. Por su parte, la expedición del Barcelona, que lleva retraso, se va a alojar en Issy-les-Moulineaux, más alejado del centro y de las principales plazas donde los ciudadanos convocaron sus protestas. El fin se semana Francia vivió una jornadas de enorme violencia. En Limoges Ayuntamiento hay quedado destruido tras un ataque incendiario que provocó el derrumbe de su histórica aguja de 143 años. En París, Lyon o Marsella ha habido saqueos masivos a supermercados, farmacias, tiendas de ropa y boutiques de lujo (como Louis Vuitton y Dior). O quema de un restaurante, contenedores y mobiliario urbano.

articles.title: Carvajal entra en la lista para jugar frente al Rayo
articles.standfirst: El futbolista madrileño podría tener sus primeros minutos con el Getafe
articles.summary: El futbolista madrileño podría tener sus primeros minutos con el Getafe
articles.body: El entrenador del Getafe, José Bordalás, ha dado a conocer la lista de convocados para el encuentro de hoy frente al Rayo Vallecano (21:00 horas) en el Coliseum, un duelo clave para ambos equipos para dar un salto en la tabla de cara al objetivo de la temporada. En ella está el nuevo futbolista azulón, Dani Carvajal, que podría tener sus primeros minutos. El lateral, que llegó el pasado martes y se ha ejercitado con el resto de sus compañeros durante la semana, podría debutar en el duelo madrileño y frente a su afición. Con ello, Bordalás le da a Carvajal esa confianza que ya dejó ver en sala de prensa, donde afirmó que el futbolista “está preparado”, con la duda ahora de si Carvajal saldrá de inicio o tendrá que esperar al segundo tiempo para debutar con su nueva casaca. La gran noticia, además de la inclusión del nuevo futbolista, es el regreso de Enes Ünal, que se ejercitó estas últimas sesiones con sus compañeros y podrá estar disponible para el entrenador alicantino en un duelo vital contra los de Beñat San José. La mala noticia son las ausencias de tres piezas clave como Iván Azón, Orel Mangala y Zaid Romero, que no se han recuperado de sus dolencias y deberán esperar, al menos, al jueves para poder volver al terreno de juego.

articles.title: James McClean: Charity offers to meet footballer over therapy comments
articles.summary: Michael Lynch, from Men's Action Network (MAN) offered to meet the Derry City footballer James McClean.
articles.body:
A men's mental health charity has offered to meet footballer James McClean after he told a newspaper he views speaking to a psychologist as "weak".

In an interview with the Sunday Independent , the Derry City player said he had never tried therapy because "as a man I would see that as a weakness".

Michael Lynch, from Men's Action Network (MAN) based in Londonderry, said the charity would welcome the opportunity to meet with him to discuss the importance of encouraging all men to feel comfortable seeking support when they need it.

McClean, who is currently not playing for his hometown club amid an ongoing contract dispute , gave the comments during a wide-ranging interview on topics including his new book, which details the social media abuse he has faced for refusing to wear a poppy, as well as death threats he has received.

The former Sunderland, West Bromwich Albion and Stoke City player spoke about his wife's view that he had "built-up anger and frustration" that he had blocked out, to which the interviewer asked him if he had ever tried therapy.

McClean responded that he had heard his brother, fellow Derry City player Patrick McClean, "on a call to a club psychologist, having a lovely chat".

"And a lot of the players speak to him and for me that's just weak.

"As a man, I see that as weakness. I don't need to open up.

"I see it as a weakness that I'd have to speak to someone about my feelings, my emotions."

'Asking for help isn't a sign of weakness'

Lynch said he would welcome a meeting with McClean to discuss his views, as first reported by Derry Now .

He told BBC News that NI McClean was entitled to his views and "neither I nor anyone else is entitled to say otherwise, because men's mental health is such a complex issue".

"In some ways, I agree with him, in the sense that he mentioned that the only person who can decide whether seeking support is right for them is the person themselves, because nobody can do it for you.

"But what I and others involved with MAN would say is that there is certainly still a stigma around men feeling that they cannot reach out at times and say, 'I am not OK and need to seek support', when that is so far from the truth."

Lynch added that "asking for help isn't a sign of weakness".

"For men to recognise that they need support and act on it is incredibly brave."

Lynch said James McClean was an influential figure, particularly for young men from Derry, given his sporting and personal achievements.

"We would obviously welcome a meeting with someone of that stature, for him to come and meet with the people we speak with every day, and we would love for him to have a conversation with us.

"I think it would be really beneficial for people to hear from someone who has achieved so much in his career and has been a role model for so many people, to show what can be achieved with hard work."

James McClean has had an acclaimed club and international career, having earned 103 caps for the Republic of Ireland.

The 37-year-old began his career at Derry City before moving to Sunderland and appearing for a number of clubs in the Premier League and Championship, including Sunderland, West Bromwich Albion, Stoke and Wigan Athletic.

He later made more than 100 appearances for Wrexham in all competitions, scoring eight goals, before returning to Derry City in January last year.

His return to his hometown club, however, has been derailed by a contract dispute which he has described as "incomprehensible".

McClean has described the past few months as "one of the most difficult periods of his life" and also apologised over social media posts in which he aired frustrations over the ongoing issues at Derry.

articles.title: La radiografía a la crisis del 'calcio': "Ven a los jóvenes como un problema y a los veteranos como una garantía"
articles.standfirst: El seleccionador sub 21, que ejerció de interino de la absoluta, denuncia el sistema vigente
articles.summary: El seleccionador sub 21, que ejerció de interino de la absoluta, denuncia el sistema vigente
articles.body: El seleccionador sub 21 de Italia, Silvio Baldini, que dirigió de forma interina a la absoluta entre abril y julio pasados, ha afirmado que la causa de la crisis del fútbol italiano "son sus dirigentes", quienes siguen lógicas económicas y no se preocupan "por comprobar si un chico tiene talento". En un acto en Roma en el marco de la entrega de los premios 'Manlio Scopigno' y 'Felipe Pulici', en el que también estaba presente, entre otros directivos, el presidente interino de la Federación Italiana de Fútbol, Giovanni Malagò, Baldini cargó contra aquellos "que siguen las lógicas del beneficio económico y la visibilidad". "No se preocupan por comprobar si un chico tiene talento y puede convertirse en un recurso importante. Ven a los jóvenes como un problema y a los veteranos como una garantía", declaró con franqueza. El técnico de la sub-21, que recibió el premio especial 'Manlio Scopigno-Felice Pulici' por contribuir a la imagen de Italia en el mundo, pronunció estas palabras en el contexto de la grave crisis que atraviesa la federación, que tendrá que repetir elecciones en diciembre tras un fallo administrativo por el cual Malagò, que salió elegido en junio, no se inscribió correctamente como candidato. El fútbol italiano atraviesa dificultades y un desgate acumulado fruto de un sistema que lleva años mostrando grietas, tanto en el plano económico como deportivo e institucional. La ausencia de Italia en tres Mundiales consecutivos (2018, 2022 y 2026) convirtió la crisis en una evidencia imposible de disimular y abrió un debate sobre la dirección del 'calcio'. La mala inserción de los jóvenes en la élite, el peso excesivo de los extranjeros en la Serie A y la pérdida de competitividad de los clubes italianos en Europa son algunos de los lastres que arrastra el fútbol transalpino.

articles.title: Guruzeta se pierde toda la temporada
articles.standfirst: Las pruebas confirman la rotura del ligamento cruzado anterior en su rodilla izquierda
articles.summary: Las pruebas confirman la rotura del ligamento cruzado anterior en su rodilla izquierda
articles.body: Gorka Guruzeta se despide de la temporada. Las pruebas médicas a las que se ha sometido este lunes han confirmado que el sábado se rompió el ligamento cruzado anterior de la rodilla izquierda. El delantero conoce bien lo que supone esa lesión, pues en 2019 tuvo el mismo percance en la rodilla derecha. Entonces, el donostiarra jugaba con el Bilbao Athletic después de haber debutado ya con el primer equipo rojiblanco. El futbolista necesitará de una reparación quirúrgica, que se hará en los próximos días en un centro con cobertura IMQ, y le esperan entre seis y ocho meses de recuperación. Guruzeta cumplió 30 años de edad el pasado mes de septiembre y tiene contrato con la entidad hasta 2028. El guipuzcoano suma 186 partidos con el primer equipo del Athletic y ha marcado 48 goles. Esta temporada todavía no se había estrenado como goleador en los 5 partidos en que había tomado parte mientras que la pasada campaña hizo 17 goles en 48 encuentros. La lesión de Guruzeta deja más que tocado el ataque del Athletic. El delantero, que es futbolista de facilidad en el manejo del balón y capacidad asociativa para jugar en punta como para hacerlo unos metros por detrás, sacó su mejor versión con Valverde y ahora estaba tomando al pulso al plan de Terzic porque volvía a tomar tono tras una lesión muscular. La baja se produce todavía sin empezar la Copa y sólo con siete partidos de Liga disputados al completo. Iñaki Williams y Maroan son las alternativas a la punta de ataque que valora Terzic en el primer equipo. En caso de necesidad el alemán podría reconvertir de posición a otros futbolistas o recurrir a alguno de los futbolistas del filial que ya han entrenado a sus órdenes. Lo que ahora parece muy complicado es que la Junta Directiva estime la posibilidad de abordar un fichaje en el mercado de invierno.

articles.title: Yan Diomandé scripts history, breaking Jude Bellingham’s record to make 21st-century club history in 4-1 Sevilla thrashing
articles.summary: In a stunning 4-1 victory against Sevilla, Yan Diomandé becomes the youngest Real Madrid player this century to score and assist in a La Liga match, surpassing Jude Bellingham's record. Discover the highlights of his performance and what it means for the club's future.
articles.body: Real Madrid’s 4-1 victory over Sevilla delivered the kind of result José Mourinho wanted ahead of the looming Barcelona clash, but the evening also belonged to a teenager making his own mark on the club’s history. Yan Diomande supplied an assist and scored himself, becoming the youngest Real Madrid player this century to achieve both in a La Liga match, surpassing a record previously held by Jude Bellingham.Diomande makes history in Madrid’s Sevilla routReal Madrid were in commanding form at the Bernabéu, beating Sevilla 4-1 and building momentum before their meeting with Barcelona. Arda Güler opened the scoring after Diomande’s precise work on the wing created the opportunity, while Kylian Mbappé added a brace to put the hosts firmly in control.Diomande then produced the moment that turned an impressive performance into a historic one. The Ivorian winger surged down the flank, cut inside and drove a right-footed shot into the net, completing a night on which he had both scored and assisted.At 19 years and 338 days old, Diomande became the youngest Real Madrid player in the 21st century to record a goal and an assist in the same La Liga match. The previous mark belonged to Bellingham, who achieved the feat at 20 years and 51 days.Bellingham’s benchmark falls to a teenage teammateBellingham’s record had stood as a measure of how quickly a young player could influence a Real Madrid league match. Diomande has now moved ahead of him, doing so with a performance that combined a direct contribution to Güler’s opener with a goal of his own, a decisive contribution as Real Madrid climbed from 4th to 3rd place in the La Liga standings after their victory against Sevilla FC, moving from 18 points to 21 points.The milestone also arrives after what has been described as a difficult start to Diomande’s time at the Bernabéu. His display against Sevilla offered a reminder of the attacking qualities that made Madrid invest heavily in the young winger, although one standout performance does not settle the questions surrounding his development.Mourinho says Diomande still has plenty to learnMourinho praised Diomande’s potential but was careful not to treat the record as proof that the teenager had already reached the finished product. The manager pointed to the expectations attached to the fee Madrid paid, saying the winger was carrying a burden far greater than the number on his shirt.“He’s got a lot of room for improvement; he’s young, he’s naive – a work in progress,” Mourinho said. “Instead of playing with the number 25 on his back, he’s playing with the 125 or 130 million they paid for him.”Mourinho identified decision-making and composure in the final third as areas where Diomande still needs to improve. He also drew a comparison with Vinícius Júnior, recalling how the Brazilian developed after arriving at Madrid.“I remember Vinícius [Júnior] very well when he first arrived at Real Madrid,” Mourinho said. “Then two-three years later, Vinícius had become a truly world-class player.”Diomande’s record-breaking performance has given Madrid another young attacking talent to follow, while Mourinho’s comments made clear that the club expects the teenager’s progress to continue well beyond one memorable night against Sevilla.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.standfirst: Runrún en la grada de La Rosaleda tras el 2-5 de la Real
articles.summary: Runrún en la grada de La Rosaleda tras el 2-5 de la Real
articles.body: El Málaga de Juanfran Funes recibió ante la Real Sociedad su primer varapalo serio de la temporada. El dos a cinco del equipo donostiarra en Martiricos hizo saltar las primeras alarmas de un Funes Buque que por primera vez parece que va a la deriva. Gestos serios con cada gol encajado y un runrún en la grada que por primera vez pitó tímidamente a al juego del equipo y que incluso cantó al finalizar el partido contra la dirección deportiva al son de “¿Dónde están los fichajes?. Las pruebas del entrenador para jugar con dos delanteros no funcionaron y el Málaga toca fondo después de nueve jornadas sin conocer la victoria. En la ciudad empieza a correr la frase de que el equipo blanquiazul ha subestimado la categoría. Empiezan a correr las dudas y sobre todo la falta de experiencia desde la dirección al césped de un equipo que está pagando la novatada en la categoría élite del fútbol español. El Málaga presentó una alineación en la por primera vez alineó dos puntas de inicio y el resultado fue la partición del equipo por la mitad en un centro del campo que estuvo a merced de Gorrotxategui y Carlos Soler. La diferencia en el campo fue notoria con una Real Sociedad que presentó un once con más de 1.600 partidos en Primera contra un Málaga con apenas 200 partidos en la máxima categoría. Caras largas en la vuelta al trabajo Poco antes de las 10:30 horas, el autobús del Málaga partió desde La Rosaleda rumbo a la Ciudad Deportiva Fundación MCF, donde el equipo continuará entrenándose esta semana debido a las mejoras que se están realizando en el césped del campo Anexo. La sesión comenzó con una charla técnica, seguida de ejercicios de activación física y calentamiento grupal, antes de dar paso al trabajo táctico con balón en espacios reducidos. Los jugadores que no fueron titulares ante la Real Sociedad realizaron las tareas a mayor intensidad, con la mirada puesta en el próximo compromiso liguero. El conjunto blanquiazul, colista de Primera División con cuatro puntos, visitará este viernes al Deportivo Alavés en Mendizorroza, en el encuentro que abrirá la jornada 10. Al margen del grupo continúan Diego Murillo, Juan Cruz, Aaron Ochoa y Julen Lobete, que siguen con sus respectivos procesos de recuperación.

articles.title: Saido Berahino: Ex-West Brom & Stoke striker retires from football at 33
articles.summary: Saido Berahino, who cost Stoke City £12m when they signed him from West Bromwich Albion in January 2017, retires from football at 33.
articles.body:
Former Premier League striker Saido Berahino has retired from football at the age of 33 to concentrate on coaching Burundi.

The Midlands-bred Burundi international made his name with boyhood club West Bromwich Albion, where he had one especially prolific season of 20 Premier League and cup goals in 2014-15 before joining Stoke City for £12m in January 2017.

But, having already faltered at Albion in his latter days under Tony Pulis, Berahino flopped badly for Stoke, who went on to suffer relegation from the Premier League in April 2018.

After being given a second chance by then Stoke boss Gary Rowett, he scored five times in 2018-19. But he soon fell out of favour again until he was released by mutual consent with still three years remaining on his contract.

Having left Stoke in August 2019 for Belgium, Berahino played at Waregem and Charleroi before being signed by former Baggies boss Darren Moore at Sheffield Wednesday in August 2021.

He has since played in Cyprus, India and Slovenia, as well as for his native country, having previously been capped by England at all age levels up to and including under-21.

Berahino was twice called up for England's full squad by then manager Roy Hodgson - but was not picked to play.

Berahino reserved special thanks for his first club, for whom he scored 36 goals in 121 appearances in all competition, including a hat-trick on his first start, as a 20-year-old, against Newport County in the EFL Cup in August 2013.

In a statement, entitled 'A Letter To The Game', posted on Instagram, Berahino wrote: "I want to thank West Bromwich Albion for believing in me when I was a boy.

"Those years at the club, the goals, the fans, the moments, they will always be special. There were highs and lows, mistakes and lessons. I learned that the game can lift you up and test you at the same time.

"The time has come to hang up the boots. My body and my heart are ready for the next chapter. I am proud and grateful to now serve the Burundi national team as a coach. Giving back to the country that made me, and helping the next generation, feels right.

"To my family - you have been my strength. To the fans who stayed with me through every chapter - I will never forget your support. This is not goodbye to football. It is simply the end of one story and the beginning of another.

"Football has given me everything. From the streets of Bujumbura to The Hawthorns, from the Premier League to places I never imagined I'd play - this game carried a young refugee kid through life."

articles.body:
Despite being thrashed 5-0 by Brighton & Hove Albion at the weekend, Pierre Sage is nevertheless expected to be given more time to prove himself as Crystal Palace manager, according to reports in The Athletic .

Whilst the Eagles' board are concerned about the club's situation, particularly their defensive frailty (17 goals conceded after seven Premier League matches), they recognise that the team are not far off the pace in terms of results (14th in the table with seven points).

Sage is therefore expected to lead the London side once again in their matches against Beşiktaş JK on Thursday in the Europa League and against Newcastle United on Sunday in the league.

However, a heavy defeat in Turkey this week could force chairman Steve Parish to reconsider his position; he would not hesitate to part ways with Sage if the team's performances fail to improve over the coming matches. Highly regarded within the club, particularly by his players, the French manager must now turn things round if he is to avoid seeing his spell in England come to a premature end.

articles.title: French ministry rules out postponement of PSG vs Barcelona amid riots
articles.summary: The biggest game of the season is here as Barcelona and PSG lock horns in the UEFA Champions League on match day three of the competition tomorrow night.Head...
articles.body:
The biggest game of the season is here as Barcelona and PSG lock horns in the UEFA Champions League on match day three of the competition tomorrow night.

Heading into the game, Barcelona are in a superior vein of form but also reeling from an unexpected set of defensive setbacks.

PSG, meanwhile, also enter with some casualties and freshly off a win over Manchester City.

Given that it is a group stage encounter, the stakes are not as high as a usual Champions League game between the two sides would feature.

Yet, there has been a certain degree of worry about the security of the game, for France has been reeling under riots in recent days.

PSG vs Barcelona will go ahead as planned. (Photo by Alex Pantling/Getty Images)

The ongoing riots in France are by no means ordinary, and the social tension has led to clashes between protesters and the police in numerous areas.

There has, in that sense, been a degree of worry about such a massive clash being played amidst such riots and whether there was a need to postpone the fixture.

In fact, a union representative of the French police has asked for the match between PSG and Barcelona to be postponed as well.

Now, however, the French minister of the interior, Laurent Nunez, has confirmed via SPORT that the game will go ahead as planned.

"The postponement for the match between Paris Saint-Germain and Barça is not considered for other matches that can be played in the Champions League. The games are not in doubt."

Flick has some big decisions to take. (Photo by Fran Santiago/Getty Images)

Barcelona had an almost fully fit squad ahead of their game against Real Betis, but the clash at the weekend left the team reeling with defensive setbacks.

Eric Garcia and Jules Kounde are both injured , while Gerard Martin is also suffering from a niggle as matters stand. With PSG and Real Madrid coming up, the setbacks could not have come at a worse time.

The big question for Flick, in that sense, is how to manage the defensive situation and how much to risk at this point in the season.

Playing against PSG and winning, needless to say, would be a massive confidence boost for Barcelona.

The game against Real Madrid, however, is a far more important one to win from a long-term perspective. Flick must thus weigh the positives and the negatives before taking a binding decision.

articles.title: Sarina Wiegman extends England contract until Euro 2029
articles.summary: Sarina Wiegman has signed a two-year contract extension as manager of England Women, committing to the role until the end of Euro 2029.Her previous agreement...
articles.body:
Sarina Wiegman has signed a two-year contract extension as manager of England Women, committing to the role until the end of Euro 2029.

Her previous agreement was set to expire after the 2027 World Cup.

Wiegman has led the Lionesses to two European Championship titles, including a victory over Spain in the Euro 2025 final.

Under her tenure, England also reached the 2023 World Cup final and won the first Women's Finalissima. Prior to joining England in September 2021, Wiegman won the Euro 2017 title with the Netherlands.

The team is currently working to qualify for the 2027 World Cup in Brazil. England will face Ukraine in a two-legged playoff in December after defeating Greece 8-1 on aggregate.

Assistants Janneke Bijl and Arvid Smit, and goalkeeper coach Darren Ward, have also extended their contracts until 2029. The new deal allows Wiegman to potentially lead Team GB at the 2028 Olympics in Los Angeles.

articles.title: ‘It’s an embarrassment’: Mike Vrabel says Patriots were ‘lucky to win’ against Jets
articles.summary: The New England Patriots extended their winning streak to three games on Sunday with a 26-19 win over the New York Jets, but that doesn’t mean head coach Mik...
articles.body:
The New England Patriots extended their winning streak to three games on Sunday with a 26-19 win over the New York Jets, but that doesn't mean head coach Mike Vrabel was happy with the way his team played.

Vrabel admitted after the game that the Patriots were "lucky to win," and he was harsher toward his team on Monday morning, calling the team's turnover issues "ridiculous" and going as far as to call the team's performance "an embarrassment."

The Patriots took a 17-3 lead into halftime and seemed to be in control of the game, but some key turnovers forced them to hang on late after New York pulled within seven points in the fourth quarter. New England lost a pair of fumbles, giving the team 13 giveaways on the season, which is the second-most in the NFL.

Receiver A.J. Brown also had a rough return after missing four games with an ankle injury. Brown finished with three catches and three drops on 10 targets, and he muffed an onside kick late in the fourth quarter before tight end Eli Raridon recovered the loose ball to seal the win.

"I didn't play good. I don't know, like, my timing was off," Brown said, via Pro Football Talk . "I'm much better than what I put on display today. There's no excuses. I'll be better."

If there's one positive for New England, it's that quarterback Drake Maye hasn't turned the ball over in the last two weeks, after he had nine turnovers in the first four games of the season. So while there were a lot of turnovers in the game, at least they weren't coming from Maye.

Vrabel opened his postgame press conference by saying that the Patriots were "lucky to win" after the way they played.

"We just didn't play very well," Vrabel said, via Pro Football Talk . "We tried to beat ourselves, but we made enough plays in critical situations to help us get through here today."

Vrabel doubled down during an appearance on WEEI's The Greg Hill Show on Monday morning as he called the team's turnovers "an embarrassment."

"We turn the ball over at a historic rate, and it's ridiculous. It's an embarrassment," Vrabel said, via ESPN's Mike Reiss .

The Patriots won't have much time to clean things up, either, as they face the Chicago Bears on Thursday night on a short week. Needless to say, Vrabel will be expecting a much cleaner performance.

articles.title: Raya & Arteta use the same word to describe Madueke
articles.summary: David Raya and Mikel Arteta used the same word to describe Noni Madueke, following the winger’s match-winning performance for Arsenal against Nottingham Fore...
articles.body:
David Raya and Mikel Arteta used the same word to describe Noni Madueke, following the winger's match-winning performance for Arsenal against Nottingham Forest.

Arsenal's Noni Madueke won the Player of the Match award with his substitute display against Nottingham Forest on Sunday, coming off the bench to score the winning goal.

The former Chelsea player has been shifted to the left-wing for the last couple of Premier League fixtures, and it's going very well so far.

There had been some criticism of the 24-year-old prior to the switch, but he's still clearly highly-rated internally, with both David Raya and Mikel Arteta referring to Madueke as 'special' following the game.

"He's a special player and it's going to be a special goal for him to get the win at such a difficult ground and such a difficult team," Raya said . "So, I'm delighted for him."

Arteta added in his post-match press conference: "Noni puts a smile on my face, because he's a special character. Very much loved in and around the dressing room. The way he connects, talks to people, he's just a special guy.

"I think I saw an interview where they were asking a few of our players 'who would you call if you had a problem?' and some of them said Noni. I was surprised by that! But that's a massive credit and shows the exact sort of person he is.

"After the break, he's shown something else – another level of anger and conviction in his actions, and he's becoming now decisive in matches which is what we expect from our players."

Arsenal will hope for another positive performance from Madueke away to Bayern Munich on Wednesday, perhaps the team's biggest test of the season so far.

Gunners fans may remember that Madueke scored his first Arsenal goal against Bayern last season. But that was at the Emirates Stadium, and it will be another level if he can win his team the game in Germany.

articles.title: Man Utd players ‘unhappy’ with their teammate who lost Carrick’s trust: “He’s a problem”
articles.summary: Shortly after making his summer return, Marcus Rashford is attracting trouble at Manchester United once again.The 28-year-old became an exile at Carrington i...
articles.body:
Shortly after making his summer return, Marcus Rashford is attracting trouble at Manchester United once again.

The 28-year-old became an exile at Carrington in December 2024 when Ruben Amorim dropped him from his plans.

This prompted a mid-season loan move to Aston Villa, followed by a 'dream' summer transfer to Barcelona.

But despite a decent campaign at Camp Nou, the Blaugrana snubbed Rashford in favour of the younger Anthony Gordon and Kerim Adeyemi, prompting a return to Man Utd.

Man United teammates irritated by Marcus Rashford

(Photo by Justin Setterfield/Getty Images)

While the attacker's homecoming was slightly awkward after an 18-month exile, Carrick was seemingly delighted to accommodate Rashford , whom he had played alongside and also coached in the past.

But aside from a few flashes of brilliance, the England international has yet to lend the team a hand in this desperate moment.

Therefore, British journalist Alex Crook argues that the MUFC boss has already lost faith in his player who was an unused substitute in Sunday's draw at Leeds.

"I think he's probably peaked, you know, that season when he scored so many goals under Erik ten Hag (2022/23) and convinced them to give him this huge, big-money contract, which has been a real problem for the football club," said Crook during his appearance on talkSPORT .

"Since he came back, I was hoping that maybe his spell away at Barcelona would have sparked a new lease of life in Marcus Rashford, but we haven't seen it, in all honesty.

"I think Michael Carrick was absolutely right to put him on the bench yesterday, and the fact that he didn't bring him on at the end of the game, when United were short of goals and chasing a winner, probably tells you he doesn't at this moment in time."

Crook also feels that the Man Utd dressing room is also disgruntled with Rashford, who is the club's highest earner, but hardly justifies his hefty weekly salary of £325,000.

"I think his return has been a problem. I think there are probably some unhappy players in that dressing room because he's earning so much money.

"I think it's also been an issue for Matheus Cunha because it's his place that Marcus Rashford took, and you can see that Cunha is sulking a little bit. There was such a good balance at the top end of the pitch last season with Cunha, Mbeumo, Bruno Fernandes, Amad Diallo and Šeško when he was fit.

"Marcus Rashford, not on a personal level, but just because those players feel aggrieved, I think he's upset the balance of the attack and isn't putting the numbers on the board at the moment to justify that huge salary."

Do Man Utd players have the right to be upset with Rashford?

Last season, United's attack was properly functioning for the first time in many years. However, that department lacked depth, with Amorim and Carrick both suggesting that reinforcements are required.

Therefore, had Rashford sealed a permanent transfer to Barcelona, the plan for INEOS was to sign a replacement (although they could have bottled it, as evidenced by the left-back chase).

Moreover, even with the Englishman dropped against Leeds, Cunha still started on the bench, proving that the Brazilian's omission from the starting lineup isn't directly related to Rashford, but either to the player's regressing form or the coach's tactical plans.

All in all, it feels that everyone at the club is searching for a scapegoat to explain how the team's form collapsed over the summer, and the easiest thing to do is to point the finger at someone who wasn't around when the club was winning last season.

But while Rashford has had his shortcomings, blaming him for his teammates' poor form would be senseless.

articles.title: Man City star Guehi says taking the knee has lost impact after opting against anti-racism gesture
articles.summary: MANCHESTER, England (AP) — Manchester City defender Marc Guehi believes the gesture of soccer players taking the knee before matches might have lost its impa...
articles.body:
MANCHESTER, England (AP) — Manchester City defender Marc Guehi believes the gesture of soccer players taking the knee before matches might have lost its impact and wants to see more done in the sport's fight against racism.

Guehi, who is Black, didn't take the knee prior to kickoff in City's home game against Ipswich in the Premier League on Saturday in the first of two rounds of games dedicated to the competition's "No Room For Racism" campaign .

It isn't the first time Guehi refused to perform the gesture, which was introduced in June 2020 to show support for the Black Lives Matter campaign. Since the start of the 2022-23 season, the Premier League decided against taking the knee ahead of every match, with players instead invited to do so on certain occasions each season.

Speaking Monday at a news conference the day before City's Champions League match against AEK Athens, Guehi said it was "great" that the Premier League's anti-racism campaign was continuing.

"Whether more can be done — more can always be done," he said. "We have to see how we can move the campaign along.

"I don't think it's necessarily a football issue. I think it's a wider societal issue and football is that beacon of hope to try to get the message out. But whether more can be done, we will try, hopefully with the PFA (English soccer's players union), with the league."

Asked whether taking the knee had lost its meaning, Guehi said: "Maybe. I haven't been taking the knee for a while now, to be honest. I'd always clap, just because of what that actually signifies."

Guehi didn't go into more detail about his reasons for not taking the knee.

Another player not performing the gesture at the weekend was Leeds striker Dominic Calvert-Lewin, who stood while his teammates and opposition players for Manchester United knelt.

"Dom is more or less like, 'No, I don't go down. I show my respect by standing up, more or less,'" Leeds manager Daniel Farke said after the match, in which Calvert-Lewin scored in a 1-1 draw.

"I think each individual is different and shows respect for this campaign in a different way."

In 2021, Wilfried Zaha — a Black player who was at Crystal Palace at the time — said he would no longer be taking the knee, describing the gesture as "degrading."

"I feel like taking a knee is degrading," Zaha was quoted by The Guardian newspaper as telling the FT Business of Football conference. "Growing up, my parents just let me know that I should just be proud to be black, no matter what, and I just think we should stand tall.

"I think the meaning behind the whole thing is becoming something that we just do now. That's not enough."

Premier League CEO Richard Masters said the current "No Room For Racism" initiative, which comes during the U.K.'s Black History Month, intends to use "the reach of our players to send an important message: we are united in the fight against racism."

articles.title: Oregon star receiver Evan Stewart reportedly arrested on DUII charge
articles.summary: The Oregon Ducks picked up a 17-14 win over the Nebraska Cornhuskers on Saturday night, despite playing without several key players. One of them was star wid...
articles.body:
The Oregon Ducks picked up a 17-14 win over the Nebraska Cornhuskers on Saturday night, despite playing without several key players. One of them was star wide receiver Evan Stewart, who sat out with an undisclosed injury. Now, Stewart is reportedly facing a much bigger issue off the field.

The senior receiver was booked into jail early Sunday morning on a charge of driving under the influence of intoxicants, just hours after the Ducks' win.

Stewart arrived at Oregon as a transfer from Texas A&M, where he was a former five-star recruit. He missed the entire 2025 regular season with a knee injury, but he's bounced back as the Ducks' top target this season.

Through five games, Stewart leads Oregon with 27 catches for 352 yards and four touchdown receptions. But he was downgraded from questionable to doubtful late last week and ultimately didn't play against Nebraska.

Oregon was also without quarterback Dante Moore and receiver Jeremiah McClellan on Saturday night. The Ducks still managed to improve to 4-2 overall and 2-1 in Big Ten play.

A Springfield Municipal Jail employee said that officers booked a person identified as Evan Stewart into the jail at around 7 a.m. on Sunday on a DUII charge, according to KATU .

Stewart was reportedly released about an hour later to a third party whose name matches that of fellow Oregon receiver Dakorien Moore.

"Springfield Police tell KATU news that an Evan Stewart was booked in Springfield Municipal Jail at 7 a.m. on a DUII charge. We were told that he was released at 8 a.m. to a third party, Dakorien Moore," wrote KATU's Hallie DeVore .

KATU noted that the report came after social media posts had circulated claiming that multiple Oregon players had been arrested. As of Monday morning, Oregon had not publicly addressed Stewart's arrest, and the school had not responded to KATU's request for comment.

Obviously, this is an unfortunate development for Oregon as the team cannot afford any more losses if the Ducks are going to keep their College Football Playoff hopes alive.

articles.title: Haaland a doubt, Semenyo out - what are Man City's options?
articles.summary: Manchester City coach Enzo Maresca explores his attacking options for Tuesday's Champions League game against AEK Athens.
articles.body:
Manchester City face the prospect of being without star striker Erling Haaland for Tuesday's Champions League game against AEK Athens.

The Norway international scored twice in Saturday's 3-2 victory over Ipswich Town to take his tally to eight Premier League goals for the season, leading the top-flight scoring charts once more.

But the 26-year-old suffered a blow to the foot in the game and is now a doubt for the European night at Etihad Stadium, as City look to get back to winning ways in the competition after last week's 4-2 defeat by Paris St-Germain.

"To replace Erling is always difficult but we have some different options," said manager Enzo Maresca. "It also depends on the gameplan.

"At the moment it is Erling. Why do we need to think of a different nine if Erling is there? If something happened or we need a different nine plan, we'll see."

Should Haaland not make a recovery, it would leave Maresca with a dilemma on who to select up front after Antoine Semenyo was ruled out for eight weeks with the left knee injury he picked up in the win over Ipswich.

Haaland has scored in six consecutive top-flight games to help City to the top of the table with a flawless start from their opening seven games of the campaign.

Against Ipswich, he scored his 100th non-penalty goal in the Premier League, reaching this milestone in fewer appearances than any other player.

Maresca said Haaland "can be available" against Athens and will be assessed after Monday's training session, but that he was "quite good" on Sunday.

Players can find it difficult to feature as back-ups to Haaland, as Julian Alvarez and Omar Marmoush have found in the past, but it was a surprise when Divin Mubama was allowed to join Championship side Southampton on loan in the summer.

It left City without a natural replacement in Haaland's absence.

Maresca has previously said Semenyo can be used "as a nine" but that plan is no longer available with the Ghanaian facing the prospect of missing up to 13 matches.

One option mooted by the Italian is midfielder Phil Foden, who ended his barren run in front of goal on Saturday by scoring his first Premier League goal since December.

"Phil can be one of the solutions," said Maresca. "He played already in the past in that position so could play again, but at the moment the number nine is Erling."

Could summer signing Iliman Ndiaye be another option?

The Senegal international was often deployed as a striker in Sheffield United's promotion-winning campaign in 2022-23, scoring 14 goals to help the Blades return to the Premier League.

Last season, manager Pep Guardiola said Rayan Cherki fits playing in the false nine role "perfectly", with the Frenchman scoring in a 2-0 Carabao Cup quarter-final win over Brentford when used in that position.

The City forward appeared as a 77th-minute substitute on Saturday but hobbled straight down the tunnel at full-time with Maresca initially expecting an "even worse injury".

The Ghana international has made 10 appearances in all competitions this season, scoring two goals and providing three assists.

"To lose Antoine or any player is not good," Maresca said on Monday.

"In the first moment we expected an even worse injury, so we were more worried, but after Sunday's scan we feel much better.

"It could be eight weeks. The most important thing for him is to recover and also when he is back, probably around December, we will have a new player in terms of energy.

"It is a collateral [knee injury], something like this. It is not a muscle problem."

Jeremy Doku started on the left flank against Ipswich and should continue in that role in the absence of Semenyo.

articles.title: Demichelis: "Les dije que era un error porque Mastantuono es un jugador del Madrid"
articles.standfirst: MARCA participa en la mesa redonda virtual con el entrenador del Leipzig en la previa del partido de Champions en el Bernabéu
articles.summary: MARCA participa en la mesa redonda virtual con el entrenador del Leipzig en la previa del partido de Champions en el Bernabéu
articles.body: La carrera de Martín Demichelis le ha llevado por algunos de los escenarios más importantes del fútbol, primero como jugador y ahora desde los banquillos. De Argentina a Europa, pasó por vestuarios de primer nivel, vivió experiencias que le marcaron y fue acumulando aprendizajes que hoy forman parte de su manera de entender este deporte. En la mesa redonda virtual con varios medios, en la previa de su visita al Santiago Bernabéu, el técnico del Leipzig echó la vista atrás para repasar algunos de los capítulos que han marcado su trayectoria, sin perder de vista el presente. Hubo tiempo para hablar de Franco Mastantuono y su llegada al Real Madrid (fue él quien le hizo debutar en River con 16 años), de su etapa en el Manchester City, de lo que aprendió durante su carrera, de José Mourinho y de las experiencias que han marcado su manera de entender el fútbol. También de las dificultades que le tocó atravesar y de cómo se construye una carrera cuando el camino no siempre resulta sencillo. Diomande y su marcha del Leipzig: "Tuve algunas conversaciones con él en las que expresó su deseo de dar un paso en su carrera. Le auguro un gran futuro porque su evolución ha sido muy pronunciada en este club, que empuja mucho el crecimiento de los jóvenes. Hoy el fútbol busca extremos muy desequilibrantes y él marca diferencias tanto por izquierda como por derecha. Su manejo de la pelota con ambas piernas, su velocidad y su capacidad para recorrer hacia atrás y ganar duelos le convierten en un jugador muy completo. Dependerá de él y de cómo acompañe su evolución en una institución tan grande como el Real Madrid. No tengo dudas de que tendrá grandes entrenadores y compañeros". Mourinho y el partido frente al Madrid: "Espero ver otro equipo por nuestra parte, porque el fin de semana no fuimos nosotros en ningún aspecto importante del fútbol, ni con balón ni sin él. Estoy convencido de que podemos cambiarlo. Lo importante es que salgamos a hacer nuestro partido y no esperemos a que el rival juegue el suyo. Ojalá seamos más atrevidos y volvamos a ser un equipo que quiere cuidar la posesión. Contra el Real Madrid hay que proteger el balón porque cada vez que lo recupera genera transiciones muy peligrosas. El gol de Mbappé refleja lo que necesita el Madrid: dos pases para que cualquiera de sus atacantes pueda desequilibrar y encontrar un espacio donde parece que no lo hay. Después, definir. Es único". Hizo debutar a Franco Mastantuono con 16 años en River Plate. ¿Te esperabasa que el salta al fútbol europeo iba a ser tan complicado?: "Tiempo. Hay que repasar cuántos jugadores sudamericanos han llegado a los grandes clubes europeos y han dado resultado al día siguiente. Santiago Solari necesitó su tiempo y Gonzalo Higuaín también necesitó más de un año para adaptarse a una de las instituciones más grandes del mundo". Sus charlas con Franco y lo que necesita para volver a ser él mismo: "Franco debutó con 16 años en River no por arte de magia ni por regalo. Es una historia muy bonita, que hemos hablado con él y con los dirigentes de River antes de hacerlo debutar. Me interesaba hablar primero con sus padres para saber cómo estaban y si iban a estar preparados para lo que se venía. También quería conocer su situación contractual, porque después de la pretemporada ya pensaba dosificarlo por su edad. Era uno de los mejores a nivel físico, en todos los rangos, de los tres o cinco mejores en el día a día y, sobre todo, en recuperación. A eso se sumaban su personalidad y su capacidad para afrontar el momento. Creo que Xabi Alonso también lo han dicho al conocer a Franco: uno de sus grandes dones era su personalidad. Los dirigentes tomaron nota de su situación. En ese momento habíamos vendido a Claudio Echeverri al Manchester City y pensaron en elevar la cláusula de Franco al mismo número. Yo les dije: 'No, es un error, porque Franco es un jugador del Real Madrid'. La institución hizo un gran trabajo de comunicación con su representante y puso una cláusula que para el fútbol argentino era totalmente ilógica, porque después terminó convirtiéndose en la venta más alta a nivel nacional. No dudo de que tenga las capacidades para hacerlo ni de que tenga la personalidad necesaria. El Real Madrid no te espera, no espera a nadie, así que ojalá tenga tiempo. Ahora decidió salir a jugar. Cada uno maneja su trayectoria con su corazón, con su cabeza y con la gente que le rodea, a gusto y placer. Pero no tengo dudas de que Franco es jugador de esa institución, por personalidad y por capacidad física y técnica".
